controlled_variable: WDSat static branch permutation on exactly the Q1466 width-four plain ordinary formulas
inputs: Q1466 exact N53/N83 curve, factor base, target, original XCNF and transformed width-four XCNF hashes

orders.selector_first: target-preimage selector variable IDs first, then every other variable in original ascending order
orders.interleaved_leaves: for each normal-basis bit position, take the corresponding bits of leaves 0,1,2,3; then all remaining IDs in original ascending order

solver.baseline: Q1466 default ascending order at the identical branch, CPU and wall caps
solver.branch_metric: four WDSat conf[0]++ left-branch sites; propagation and field operations are separate
